# test_interleave.py
import pytest

from your_module import interleave  # replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b", "expected"),
    [
        ([1, 2, 3], ["a", "b", "c"], [1, "a", 2, "b", 3, "c"]),
        ([1, 2, 3, 4], ["a", "b"], [1, "a", 2, "b", 3, 4]),
        ([1, 2], ["a", "b", "c", "d"], [1, "a", 2, "b", "c", "d"]),
        ([], [], []),
        ([1, 2, 3], [], [1, 2, 3]),
        ([], ["a", "b", "c"], ["a", "b", "c"]),
        ([1], ["a"], [1, "a"]),
        (
            [None, True, (1, 2)],
            [{}, [], "x"],
            [None, {}, True, [], (1, 2), "x"],
        ),
    ],
)
def test_interleave(a, b, expected):
    assert interleave(a, b) == expected


def test_interleave_does_not_mutate_inputs():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    b = ["a", "b"]

    original_a = a.copy()
    original_b = b.copy()

    result = interleave(a, b)

    assert result == [1, "a", 2, "b", 3]
    assert a == original_a
    assert b == original_b


def test_interleave_returns_new_list_when_first_input_has_remainder():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    b = []

    result = interleave(a, b)

    assert result == [1, 2, 3]
    assert result is not a


def test_interleave_returns_new_list_when_second_input_has_remainder():
    a = []
    b = ["a", "b", "c"]

    result = interleave(a, b)

    assert result == ["a", "b", "c"]
    assert result is not b


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b"),
    [
        (None, [1, 2]),
        ([1, 2], None),
        (123, [1, 2]),
        ([1, 2], object()),
    ],
)
def test_interleave_raises_type_error_for_non_iterable_inputs(a, b):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        interleave(a, b)


def test_interleave_raises_type_error_for_generator_input():
    def gen():
        yield from [1, 2, 3]

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        interleave(gen(), ["a", "b", "c"])
